description: The file 'freeTestCases.php' is a PHP script that is part of the TestLink open source testing management project. It handles the listing of free (unassigned) test cases for a specific test project, including fetching data, setting up display tables, and rendering a webpage with test case details and associated actions.

classes.name: tlExtTable
classes.description: A class responsible for rendering extended tables in the web interface for test link.

methods.name: getColumnsDefinition
methods.description: Defines the columns to be displayed in the test cases table, including titles, filters, and types.

methods.name: init_args
methods.description: Collects URL and session parameters to initialize arguments used across the script.

methods.name: checkRights
methods.description: Verifies that the current user has the right to view test plan metrics for the project.
